name: Igneous crystallisation
description: Age of igneous crystallisation of the igneous mineral or body

name: Minimum crystallisation age
description: Minimum age for igneous crystallisation of the igneous body

name: Maximum crystallisation age
description: Maximum age for igneous crystallisation of the igneous body

name: Xenocrystic component
description: Age of xenocrystic component entrained within an igneous body. Xenocrysitic component must be older than the host body in which it resides

name: Metamorphism
description: Age of metamorphism

name: Peak metamorphism
description: Age of peak metamoprhism

name: Zeolite facies
description: Age of metamorphism to zeolite facies

name: Prehnite-pumpellyite facies
description: Age of metamorphism to prehnite-pumpellyite facies

name: Greenschist facies
description: Age of metamorphism to greenschist facies

name: Blueschist facies
description: Age of metamorphism to blueschist facies

name: Eclogite facies
description: Age of metamorphism to ecologite facies

name: Amphibolite facies
description: Age of metamorphism to amphibolite facies

name: Granulite facies
description: Age of metamorphism to granulite facies

name: High pressure
description: Age of high pressure metamorphism

name: High temperature
description: Age of high temperature metamorphism

name: Ultra-High temperature
description: Age of ultra-high temperature metamorphism

name: Second metamorphic event
description: Age the second metamorphic event experienced by metamoprhised rock or terrane

name: Third metamorphic event
description: Age the second metamorphic event experienced by metamoprhised rock or terrane

name: Post-peak metamorphism (cooling age)
description: Age of post-peak metamorphism

name: Cooling
description: Age at which a body cooled below a certain temperature, usually specified by the technique used to evaluate the cooling age. Cooling temperature is genrally below temperatures assoicated with igneous crystallisation, melt generation or peak metamorphis,

name: Sedimentary age
description: Age associated with a sedimentary sequence, either clastic or chemical. Due to the multi-component nature of most sedimentary sequences (particularly clastic sequences) ages obtained from sediments may contain information on the age of the sequence itself, age of the protolith(s), or subsequent system disturbance

name: Stratigraphic
description: Exact age of deposition of clastic detritus, and/or the chemical precipitation of minerals which form a sedimentary sequence

name: Maximum depositional age
description: Maximum age of deposition of clastic detritus, and/or the chemical precipitation of minerals to form a sedimentary sequence

name: Detrital component
description: Age of a detrital component observed within the sedimentary sequence

name: Primary detrital component
description: Age of main detrital component observed within the sedimentary sequence

name: Secondary detrital component
description: Age of secondary detrital component observed within the sedimentary sequence

name: Tertiary detrital component
description: Age of third detrital component observed within the sedimentary sequence

name: Fourth detrital component
description: Age of fourth detrital component observed within the sedimentary sequence

name: Minimum depositional age
description: Minimum age of deposition of clastic detritus, and/or the chemical precipitation of minerals to form a sedimentary sequence

name: Diagenesis
description: Age of physical or chemical modification of sedimentary materials within a sedimentary sequence following sedimentation, but prior to any subsequent metamorphism or weathering

name: Disconformity
description: Age of a disconformity relating to an adjacent erosional surface within a sedimentary sequence.

name: Nonconformity
description: Age of a disconformity relating to an adjacent erosional surface between igneous or metamorphic units and sedimentary units.
